notes: Agent relay: chain agents with one voice command — 'Kai, make a plan, then open a claude agent and have it verify and summarize it back to me.' Each agent runs in turn, hands its result to the next, and Dave speaks the final summary aloud. Your named agents are always respected, chains run quietly on the canvas, and agent launches now wait for the CLI to be fully ready before delivering instructions (no more lost handoffs). Plus: Moonshot's Kimi K3 (Kimi Code) joins as a first-class provider, Codex responds to routed commands without a manual Enter, and voice waits for you to finish speaking before acting.
